Commentary.Commentary: 240 is not a big target and Australia will fancy themselves to chase this down. Sri Lanka will need to bowl really well if they are to defend this. Join us for the chase in a while.

The Australian bowling was nice and disciplined. Starc and Cummins started off really well. Then Maxwell, Lyon and Zampa continued the good work. Kane Richardson was the only bowler who was not upto the mark today. Overall though, Australia will be happy with their effort.

So Sri Lanka have crawled their way to 239! Not sure if they will be happy with their effort especially after electing to bat first. They though got off to a sedate but decent start. However, they kept losing wickets at regular intervals which always kept them behind the 8-ball game. Thirimanne played as the anchor but he needed to continue after getting to his half ton. It was Dhananjaya's innings which gave them the much-needed impetus and also, it was courtesy him that the Lankan bowlers have something to bowl at.
Low full toss outside off, Siriwardana carves it through point. The batsmen get two runs. 7 runs have come from the over. SRI LANKA FINISH WITH 239/8 IN THEIR 50 OVERS.
Full on middle, Lakmal drives it to long on. The batsmen change ends.
BEATEN! Short delivery, Lakmal looks to pull but misses it.
Short delivery outside off, Lakmal pulls it towards Cummins who goes for the catch but it fell just short of Cummins.
FOUR! Nice shot and a much-needed boundary. Length delivery on middle, Lakmal lofts it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Bowls a wide yorker outside off, Lakmal looks to chase that delivery but misses it.
Fuller in length, Milinda flicks it to mid-wicket for a couple. And a wicket finally for Starc in this over.
Fuller length on the pads, Milinda looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Milinda Siriwardana is the new batsman in.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! You miss, I hit stuff. Starc keeps it full and attacks the stumps. Dhananjaya looks to go over the off side by making room but misses to see the ball hit the leg pole. A good innings though from him. He provided the much-needed impetus to the Lankan innings but they needed him to stay out there till the end.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
BEATEN! Length ball outside off, Lakmal looks to defend it off the back foot but the ball goes past the outside edge. Perfect delivery for a number 9 batsman.
Short of good length, de Silva pulls it towards mid-wicket and they cross over.
BEATEN! Cummins bowls a short delivery, Lakmal looks to pull but misses it. 3 runs and a wicket from the over. Good one for Australia.
Full on middle, Dhananjaya flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen cross ends.
Bowls a wide yorker outside off, Dhananjaya lets it go.
Short of a length delivery, Lakmal looks to defend but gets hit on the glove. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen cross ends.
Full on middle, Dhananjaya flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Suranga Lakmal is the next man in.

OUT! Perera holes out! Cummins strikes on the first ball of his new spell. Bowls it short and on the body of Perera. He goes for the pull but since it was the longer part of the ground, he needed to get a lot behind it. Does not do so and it is an easy catch for Maxwell at deep mid-wicket. A good partnership for the Lankans comes to an end but they needed this to continue.
A couple to end a very good 47th! Just the 5 from it. Short and it is the slower one. Dhananjaya pulls it through mid-wicket and takes two.
Just a single! This is a top over so far! A yorker on middle, Perera jams it out towards cover for a single.
Good bouncer! It is on the body again. Perera ducks under it. He may have been surprised by that delivery.
Nicely played! Opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a single.
Cramps the batsman for room by bowling it on the body. Dhananjaya pushes it back to the bowler. A dot, rare one in the last few overs.
A yorker first up, it is on the pads, Perera hits it down to long on for a single.
Mitchell Starc is back on!
Full on off, Dhananjaya lofts it over covers. The batsmen pick up a couple. 11 runs have come from this over. 38 runs have come from the last three. Sri Lanka have started to accelerate.
Short and outside off, Thisara cuts it through point. The batsmen cross ends.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Kane Richardson. Short and outside off, Perera cuts it over point for a boundary.
Short delivery, Dhananjaya makes room and plays a paddle sweep over short fine leg. The batsmen cross ends.
50-run stand between Thisara Perera and Dhananjaya de Silva. Short and outside off, Dhananjaya cuts it over point. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Bowls a yorker on middle, Thisara moves away and drives it towards mid off for a single.
FOUR! Flighted delivery outside off, The batsman dances down the track and lofts it over mid-wicket and the ball crosses the ropes on bounce. 13 runs coming in this over.
Flatter on off, de Silva looks to paddle it over the keeper but fails to lay bat on ball.
FOUR! Flighted outside off, de Silva goes on his knees and slog sweeps it through mid-wicket and splits the gap to perfection for a boundary.
Flatter outside off, Thisara punches this off the back foot through covers for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, de Silva lofts it over the bowler's head off the toe end of the bat and they get a single. 200 come sup for Lanka.
Good Running! Lyon bowls this one flatter and on the stumps, Perera cuts it hard through point. The fielder in the deep does well to throw it back to the keeper. They get 3 runs in the process.
Short delivery on middle, Perera pulls it through square leg for a run. 14 runs have come from the over. Big over for Sri Lanka.
Full on off, Dhananjaya lofts it over wide mid off. The fielder chases it and does well to stop it before the ropes. The batsmen get three runs.
Short delivery on middle, Perera pulls it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen change ends.
Full and outside off, Dhananjaya plays it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Dhananjaya de Silva. Short and outside off, Dhananjaya easily guides it towards third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Excellent shot. Short of a length delivery, Dhananjaya pulls it over mid on for a boundary.
Flatter and outside the off stump, Dhananjaya brings out the reverse sweep and places it perfectly between point and covers for a single.
Kane Richardson is back!
Flatter outside off, Perera punches this through covers for a single.
Bowled on the shorter side and wide outside off, Perera looks to cut but gets a top edge  which just falls short of the fielder at  short third man. Luck is on Perera's side.

Good effort in the end by Marsh! Dhananjaya sweeps it firmly towards deep mid-wicket. Marsh runs to his left but misfields. The ball then trickles towards the ropes. Marsh gets up and then runs towards the ball, leaps forward and then seems to have flicked it back in. The umpire goes upstairs to check. Replays indicate it is touch and go. In the end it is ruled in the favor of the fielder. Saves a run in the end.
Flighted delivery on the stumps, the batsman flicks it to mid-wicket
It's been driven superbly through the covers. One run added to the total.
Length delivery on middle, Perera flicks it towards leg side. The batsmen change ends.
On a length on middle, Dhananjaya plays it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full again on middle, Perera flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen cross ends.
Full on middle and leg, Dhananjaya flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.

OUCHH! That might have hurt Perera nastily. Starc bowls one short but it doesn't rise as expected. Perera looks to duck  under it but get hits on the arm. The batsmen steal a leg bye in the process. Sri Lanka won't mind how the runs come, they want it desperately.
Fuller length delivery on the stumps, Perera strokes it straight to covers.
Mitchell Starc is back on!
Short and outside off, Perera makes room and cuts it through point. The batsmen get three runs. Good running between the wickets.
Flighted delivery on off, Perera defends it out.
Tossed up on off, Perera looks to flick but gets a leading edge. It goes to off side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller ball outside off, Dhananjaya reverse sweeps it to third man and the batsmen cross for a single.
Length ball on the stumps, Thisara flicks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Floated delivery on off, Dhananjaya defends it out. Just 3 runs from the over.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of the innings.
Short and outside off, Thisara makes room and slaps it through covers for a run.
Short and outside off, Thisara makes room and cuts it through point. The batsmen get two runs.
Floated on off, Thisara plays it to point.
Flighted delivery on off, Thisara plays it to covers.
Tossed up on off, Perera drives it to covers.
Flighted delivery on the stumps, defended off the front foot by presenting the full face off the bat. Just 3 runs from the over.
Flatter ball outside off, the batsman punches off the back foot through the covers and takes a single on offer.
OHH EDGE! But safe. Lyon bowls one outside off and the ball grips the surface, Perera looks to drive but gets a leading edge towards point. Luck for Perera and Lanka.
Flatter on the stumps, Punched towards the off side.
Flatter outside off, punched off the back foot by Perera.
Flighted delivery outside off, de Silva dances down the track and drives it to long on. A single taken.
BEATEN! Short and just outside off, Thisara looks to cut but misses it. 2 runs and a wicket from the over. Productive over from Australia's point of view.
Thisara Perera is the new man in.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Zampa gets his second. Mendis looks to sweep but misses. He is hit right in front. An appeal and the umpire raises the finger. Jeevan walks back after getting off to a start.
Floated on off, Dhananjaya plays it towards point for a run.
Flighted delivery on middle, Dhananjaya comes down the track and keeps it out.
Tossed up on middle, Dhananjaya defends it off the back foot.
Flighted delivery on leg, Mendis sweeps it to short fine leg for a single.
Flighted delivery outside off, de Silva dances down to flick but at the last moment defends it off the bottom edge back to the bowler.
Flighted on the stumps, Mendis works it towards the leg side for a single.
Flatter again, this time Dhananjaya succeeds in flicking the ball past mid-wicket with a wristy shot. A run added to the total.
Flatter delivery on the stumps, de Silva flicks it to mid-wicket.
Flighted on the off stump, Mendis sweeps it through the deep backward square leg region for a single.
Flighted outside off, punched down to long on for a single.
Nathan Lyon comes back again.
Tossed up on off, Jeevan defends it off the front foot. 7 runs have come from the over.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Mendis looks to go after it but misses it.
Floated delivery on middle, Jeevan flicks it to leg side.
FOUR! Nice shot. Floated on middle, Mendis plays a reverse sweep behind point for a boundary.
Flighted delivery on middle, Mendis defends it out.
Tossed up on off, Mendis defends it out.
Flighted delivery on off, Mendis plays it through covers. The batsmen pick up a couple. 150 up for Sri Lanka.
Adam Zampa is back into the attack.
Pitching outside off, Dhananjaya again lets the ball go through to the keeper.
Pitching on a length and outside off, de Silva shoulders arms and the keeper does the rest.
Length ball outside off, Dhananjaya defends it with a solid front foot defence.
Short of good length and rising, the batsman does well to jump on his toes and defend it to the off side.
Short of length, Mendis plays the pull through the mid-wicket region for a single.
On a length and in line, Jeevan looks to fend that away to the on side but gets an inside edge onto the thigh pad.
Floated delivery on off, Dhananjaya drives it towards Steven Smith, where the bowler dives and does well to stop it. 2 runs and a wicket from the over. Fine over from Steven Smith.
Tossed up on off, Dhananjaya drives it to covers.
Dhananjaya de Silva is the new  man in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Smith gets the big fish! Mathews will be very disappointed with himself. He is the last bowler in this Australian team he would have wanted to get out to. This is extremely full on middle, bounces just before the bat. Mathews looks to drive it but it goes uppishly to the left of the bowler who takes a good catch diving to his left. Half the side back in the hut for Sri Lanka. They slip further.
Full toss on leg, Mendis flicks it towards square leg for a run.
Short delivery on middle, Mathews pulls it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on off, Mathews drives it to covers.
A single to end the over! Short and outside off, AM guides it through point for a run.
Good length on off, it is kept out.
Mendis takes another single as he works it through square leg.

In the air... safe! Short ball on the body, Mathews looks to pull but it goes off the top edge towards fine leg. The fielder there is late to pick up the ball and the ball bounces in front of him. The batsmen get a single.
Length delivery on the pads, Jeevan flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Pitching on a length and outside off, Mendis taps it to point.
Pat Cummins is back into the attack.
Short and outside off, Mendis cuts it through point. The batsmen pick up a couple. 7 runs have come from Steven Smith's first over.
Usman Khawaja is walking off. In the meantime the umpires signals for Drinks.
Full on off, Jeevan drives it to mid off where Usman Khawaja does well to stop it and gets hurt in the process.
Tossed up on middle, Mathews drives it to long on for a single.
Floated on middle, Mathews defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Mathews looks to cut but gets an outside edge. It goes towards third man for a boundary.
Floated on middle, Mendis tucks it towards the leg side for a single.
Steven Smith is on now!

Length ball on the pads, Mendis flicks it behind square on the leg side for a single. Jeevan Mendis is clearly struggling against the pace of Starc. He has had a few play and miss against the quickie.
WIDE! This has been the norm with Starc. Again down leg and wide signaled
Length ball on the stumps, defended back to the bowler.
Fuller in length and on pads, Angelo flicks it through mid- wicket for a single.
Pitching outside off, pushed to covers.
On a length and outside off, pushed to point and Mathews get a single.
Length ball outside off, the  batsman looks to defend off the back foot but gets  an outside edge towards third man for a single.
Full on off, Mendis drives it to long off for a single.
Short delivery on middle, Mathews pulls it through mid-wicket. The batsmen cross ends.
Floated on middle, Angelo flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Tossed up on off, Jeevan plays it towards covers for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Mendis drives it to covers.
Tossed up on middle, Mendis flicks it to mid-wicket.

Right on the helmet! Nasty, nasty delivery by Starc. He bangs it short and it is very well-directed. Mendis is a little too late to duck under it. The ball hits the glove and then hits the helmet. Lobs away from the point fielder and a single is taken. Mendis is lucky there. That could have gone anywhere.
Length ball on middle, Mendis flicks it to mid-wicket.
Length ball on the off stump, JM looks to flick it through the on side but gets a soft leading edge towards the off side.
WIDE! Two good deliveries and Again one down leg. Wide signalled.
BEATEN AGAIN! Starc getting in his groove. Fuller again and outside off, JM looks to push again to the off side and beaten once again. There is no feet movement from the batsman.
BEATEN! No feet movement from the batsman. Fuller in length Starc is getting the ball to swing, batsman looks to push towards the off side but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Short ball on the body, JM tucks it to leg slip.
WIDE! Short and down the leg side. Wide signalled.
FOUR! Nice shot. Tossed up on middle, Mathews comes down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary. 5 runs and a wicket from the over. Productive over for Australia.
Flighted delivery on middle, Mendis plays a sweep towards mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up on middle, Jeevan defends it off the back foot.
Floated delivery on off, Mendis plays it off the back foot.
BEATEN! Straightaway trouble for the new batsman. Flighted delivery just outside off, Jeevan Mendis looks to defend but misses it due to the away turn on this one.
Jeevan Mendis is the new batsman in.

OUT! Excellent catch from Nathan Lyon in the deep. Not the best of deliveries from Zampa. He bowls a very low full toss on off, Kusal Mendis looks to sweep it over deep mid-wicket. He gets no timing on it but for a moment it looks to be falling short but Lyon dives in front and takes a brilliant catch just over the ground.
Length ball outside off, AM defends it off the front foot.
Short ball on the stumps, The batsman does well to defend it off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, KM taps it to third man for a single.
Fuller on legs, KM flicks it uppishly to deep mid-wicket and till the bowl gets fielded they get a couple.
Length and on the pads, the batsman flicks it to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Starc bowls one down leg. Umpire does the exercise to signal wide.
Fuller in length outside off, driven to covers.
Starc comes on again.
Floated on middle, Mendis flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run. Just 3 runs from the over. This has been a good spell of bowling from Zampa till now.
Flighted delivery on off, Mathews punches it towards point for a single.
Tossed up on off, Mathews defends it out.
Flighted delivery outside off, Angelo leaves it alone.
Floated on middle, Mathews defends it off the back foot.
Flighted delivery on off, Mendis drives it to long off for a single.
Angelo Mathews  is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Another batsman who looks to play for the turn departs! Lovely delivery from Lyon. He pushes this one quicker, at 91 KPH. It lands on off and then skids through. Thirimanne ends up playing outside the line, he also leaves a gap between bat and pad. The ball sneaks through and hits the off pole. Once again Australia manage to strike at the right time. The partnership just started to get going.
Short delivery on off, Thirimanne cuts it to point.
Floated on middle, Thirimanne plays a paddle sweep towards fine leg. The batsmen get two runs.
Flighted delivery on middle, Mendis sweeps it through mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up on off, Thirimanne drives it through covers for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Mendis flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
The slider and it is outside off, Thirimanne waits for it and guides it to short third man. Another productive over for Lanka. 9 from it and 15 have come from the last two.
The googly, Mendis picks it and works it towards mid-wicket for one. Sensible batting.
FOUR! Short ball and put away! Mendis rocks back and has enough time to hit it in the gap in the mid-wicket region.
Uses his feet now and works it through mid-wicket for one. 100 up.
Thirimanne looking to get a move on! He sees this short and pulls it through square leg for a brace.
Very full and on off, Mendis hits it through covers and takes one.
FOUR! 50 for Thirimanne. Nice innings from him. Floated on middle, Thirimanne dances down the track and lofts it over mid-wicket for a boundary. 6 runs have come from the over.
Floated delivery on middle, Mendis nudges it towards square leg. The batsmen cross ends.
Tossed up on middle, Mendis drives it to mid on.
Flighted delivery on middle, Mendis nudges it to leg side.
Tossed up on middle, Mendis defends it out.
Flighted delivery on middle, Thirimanne comes down the track and lofts it over mid-wicket. The batsmen take a run.
Tossed up on middle, Kusal defends it off the back foot. Just 1 run from the over. Adam Zampa is getting lot of turn.
Floated on off, Mendis defends it off the bottom blade of the bat.
BEATEN! Little bit of turn on this one. Tossed up just outside off, Mendis looks to defend but misses it due to the away spin on this one.
Floated on off, Mendis defends it off the front foot.
Flighted delivery on leg, Thirimanne plays a paddle sweep towards fine leg for a run.
Tossed up on middle, Thirimanne drives it to mid on.
OHHHH! Edge and safe. Flatter on the stumps, KM looks to flick through the leg side, gets a soft leading edge towards covers.
Tossed up delivery outside off, the batman gets right behind the ball and defends it.
FOUR! Tossed up delivery on middle and leg, KM flicks it fine off the short fine leg fielder and the ball races away to the boundary rope despite a chase from the short fine leg fielder.
Shorter in length, cut towards point and the batsman cross over. A run added to the total.
Flatter on middle, punched of the back foot towards long on for single.
Tossed up delivery on the stumps, LT eases this through covers for a single.
Nathan Lyon comes on to bowl.
Full on off, Mendis drives it to mid off. 4 runs from Zampa's first over. Good start from him.
Floated delivery on middle, Thirimanne comes down the track and hits it towards mid on for a single.
Short and outside off, Thirimanne makes room and cuts it through point. The batsmen get two runs.
Flighted delivery on middle, Thirimanne drives it back towards the bowler.
Short delivery on middle, Mendis pulls it over wide mid on for a single.
Zampa starts with a tossed up delivery outside off, Mendis offers no shot to this one.
Adam Zampa comes on to bowl for the first time in this innings.
Well played! This is tossed up on off, Mendis guides it through point and gets to the other end.
Just a single as Thirimanne goes back and punches it through covers for one.
Another dot! Runs hard to come by for the Lankans. Thirimanne comes down the track and flicks it but straight to mid-wicket.
Flighted ball on off, Thirimanne finds cover with a drive.
On the shorter side and on the stumps, Mendis goes back and pushes it through wide mid on for one.
Flatter and around off, Mendis lunges and defends it.
Length delivery on middle, Mendis flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Length delivery on off, Thirimanne dabs it towards third man for a run.
On a good length on off, Thirimanne looks to defend but gets a bottom edge on this one.
Length delivery on middle, Lahiru flicks it to the leg side.
Good ball from Marcus Stoinis. On a good length on middle, Thirimanne does well to defend it off the back foot. There is a bit of inswing on this one.
Length delivery on middle, Thirimanne flicks it to mid-wicket.
Fired on the pads, Thirimanne looks to flick but misses. The ball hits the pads and rolls towards square leg. A leg bye taken. End of a successful over for Australia.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
This is shorter and on middle, Mendis works it through square leg and gets to the other end.
Good length on off, Mendis stands tall and keeps it out.
Kusal Mendis is the next batsman in.

OUT! LBW! Maxwell strikes. The dangerous Perera does not make the life he got, count. The arm ball does the trick. It is flatter and it skids on after pitching on off. Perera lunges and looks to defend but does so for the turn. There is no spin whatsoever and Perera is hit on the front pad. An appeal, a long one and the umpire finally raises the finger. Perera walks upto his partner and has a chat but then keeps on walking. Another budding partnership comes to an end. It was a good decision not to review as replay later on show that it was plumb in front.
Tosses it up on middle, Perera works it to the left of the bowler. Maxwell gets there quickly and stops the single.
DRINKS BREAK! Australia have bowled well and picked up a solitary wicket of Dimuth Karunaratne. They would look to pick more wickets and put pressure on Sri Lanka.

Full on off, Perera hits it over covers. Usman Khawaja chases it and does well to stop it. The batsmen get three runs. Good running between the wickets. 6 runs have come from the over and 10 runs have come from the last two.
On a length on middle, Perera flicks it to the leg side.
On a good length on leg, Kusal looks to defend but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Length delivery on middle, Thirimanne nudges it towards square leg for a run.
Short and outside off, Thirimanne cuts it to point.
Short of a length delivery, Thirimanne pulls it through square leg where Maxwell slides and does well to stop it and saves two runs for the team. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Flatter on the pads, Thirimanne this time works it to the mid-wicket region for a single. Maxwell has conceded just four singles in this over. Good bowling this.

Flatter outside off, Thirimanne looks to cut off the back foot but the spinner gets some extra bounce too and this means the batsman fails to put bat on ball. Not far away from taking the outside edge.
Tossed up on the stumps, Perera dances down the track and strokes it to long off. Both the batsman cross over for a run.
Tossed up on the stumps, defended off the front foot.
Bowled on the pads, Thirimanne works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Flat on the stumps, driven to covers for a single.
Length delivery on off, Perera punches it towards point for a run. Good start from Marcus Stoinis. Just 3 runs from the over.
Good length delivery on off, Kusal defends it out.
Short of a length delivery, Lahiru pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Full on off, Thirimanne drives it to mid off.
On a good length on off, Thirimanne defends it out.
Length delivery on middle, Kusal Perera flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Marcus Stoinis is into the attack.
Tossed up on the stumps, defended off the front foot. A tight over by Maxwell, just a run from it.
Flatter on off, driven through covers, but a spirited effort from the fielder saves runs.
Flat on the stumps, driven to mid on .
flatter and straighter, the batsman drives to mid on.
Flatter on the pads, worked towards leg side for a single.

Flatter on the stumps, The batsman looks to punch off the back foot through the off side but gets an inside edge onto the pads. An appeal from the bowler but the umpire is unmoved. That inside edge saved him there or he would have been a goner.
On a good length on off, it is kept out. Another good over for the Lankans.
This is angled away from the leg stump, the batter looks to work it on the leg side but due to the angle, he gets a soft leading edge to covers.
This is wider outside off, Thirimanne once again makes a leave.
Good length outside off, it is left alone.
FOUR! Three boundaries in a row for Sri Lanka once again! Shorter this time on off, LT stands tall and guides it past point. The ball races away to the fence.
FOUR! Nicely played! Length and around off, Thirimanne waits for it and then times it past point. It races away to the fence. Two boundaries in two balls for Sri Lanka.
FOUR! Nice shot from Kusal Perera. Short and outside off, Perera plays a late cut towards third man for a boundary. 5 runs from Glenn Maxwell's over.

A huge shout for LBW which has been turned down and run out opportunity also goes abegging. First, Maxwell fires it on the pads, Perera looks to sweep but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls towards the leg side. Perera is off for a run but his partner sends him back. The keeper goes for the ball, he picks it up and instead of underarming it to Smith he looks for a direct hit but misses. It hits Smith's boot and then goes towards cover. The batsman makes it back. A big miss that! Perera was a goner. Two run out opportunities missed by Australia today.
BEATEN! Floated just outside off, Perera looks to cut but misses it.
Flighted delivery on middle, Kusal defends it out.
Floated on off, Perera defends it off the front foot.
Maxwell starts with a tossed up delivery outside off, Thirimanne drives it towards mid off for a single.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 40th over. Also, Glenn Maxwell is on now!
Length delivery close to off stump. Perera knows his off stump and lets the ball go through for the keeper to do the rest.
Kusal Perera is the new batsman in.

OUT! There is something on Ultra Edge and the on-field call has to be overturned. That is why the Australians were so confident. Richardson draws first blood and breaks the opening stand just as the runs started to come for Lanka. He bowls it short and it is angling away from the batsman. Karunaratne looks to pull but takes his eyes off the ball. It goes to Carey who takes it and appeals. The umpire shakes his head though. Australia review. Replays roll in and they show there is a top edge. Excellent review!
A review by Australia! An appeal for a caught behind has been turned down. It was a confident appeal. Let's see...
Length ball outside off, batsman looks to drive through the  off side but gets an inside edge onto his pads.

FOUR! Length ball outside off, Karunaratne moves leg side and lofts it over the covers for a boundary. It's good to see Sri Lanka has started on a positive note. They are scoring without taking any unwanted risks.
On a length and in line, defended off the back foot.
Short ball on the stumps, Thirimanne pulls it hard towards mid-wicket for a run.
On a good length on off, Dimuth defends it out.
Short delivery outside off, Karunaratne looks to pull but misses it.
On a good length on middle, Dimuth defends it out.
TOP EDGE BUT SAFE! Short delivery from Cummins, Thirimanne looks to pull but gets a top edge. It goes towards square leg and falls in no man's land. The batsmen take a run.
On a length and outside off, Dimuth plays it towards point for a single.
Length delivery on off, Karunaratne plays it to mid off.

FOUR LEG BYES! Third in the over! Poor line this! On the pads, Thirimanne looks to flick but it goes off the pads and fine down the leg side. Carey did dive but he stood no chance. 14 from the over, a much-needed one for Sri Lanka.

FOUR! Lucky boundary! Australia had just moved the first slip to the second slip position and the ball goes from the former position. Very fortunate there was the batter. Length and around off, Thirimanne looks to defend but the ball goes off the outside edge and through first slip for a boundary. Consecutive boundaries.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Shorter in length and around off, Thirimanne stands tall and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Again extra bounce does the trick and the batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Back of  a length and rising outside off, Karunaratne looks to defend but gets an outside edge which runs down to third man for a single.
On a length outside off, Thirimanne runs it  down to third man for a single.
Length delivery on off, Lahiru guides it towards third man for a run.

RUN OUT CHANCE! MISSED! On a length on off, Karunaratne defends it towards off side and wants the single but Thirimanne is not at all interested. Karunaratne was halfway down the track. Cummins gets to the ball quickly and has a shy at the keeper's end but misses it. It goes towards fine leg. In the end the batsmen manage to take the single. Cummins was in a hurry to get rid of the ball there and was also off balance. He could have taken a little more time there. Karunaratne was goner had the bowler hit.
Bowls a bouncer outside off, Thirimanne looks to pull but misses it.
Length delivery outside off, Lahiru dabs it towards third man for a run.
On a good length on off, Thirimanne defends it off the front foot.
Length delivery outside off, Thirimanne taps it to point.
Length ball outside off,  Karunaratne looks to guide it towards third man but the extra bounce means the ball misses the ball and lands safely in the keeper's gloves.
Short ball on the stumps, Karunratne Pulls away to fine leg for a brace.
Pitching outside off, punched to the off side.
The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Short of length , the batsman looks to pull but fails to put bat on ball.
Length ball played towards covers.
WIDE! KR looses his radar and sprays one doen the line. Wide signalled by the umpire.
A little too straight, Karunaratne looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal but it is slipping down leg.
Kane Richardson is on now!
Length delivery outside off, Dimuth guides it towards third man for a run. 4 runs have come from the over. A good one from Mitchell Starc.
On a length on middle, Dimuth flicks it to mid-wicket.
On a good length on off, Karunaratne defends it off the front foot.

NOT OUT! Karunaratne is in! The interesting thing here though was, the LED bails lit up even before the ball hit the stumps as Carey's glove touched it first. Since it did not fall though, it would have still been out if Dimuth was short. Length and into the pads, DK flicks it through backward square leg. They take one and then go for the second.The fielder throws it to the keeper, at first it seemed like a direct hit and the umpire takes it upstairs to check. Replays roll in and they show that it was Carey's gloves which lit up the bails but it did not fall off. He then collected and dislodged it but Dimuth was in.
A direct hit! Karunaratne is the man in question. Could be close!
On a good length on off, Karunaratne defends it off the back foot.
On a length on middle, Thirimanne plays it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery on middle, driven straight to bowler.
Length ball outside off, driven crisply just to find covers.
Pitching in line of the stumps , Karunaratne flicks it behind square on the leg side for a couple.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Good length delivery, Karunaratne looks to tuck but gets hit on the thigh pad due to extra bounce.
Length ball on the pads, tucked to square leg.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. A solitary run from the over.
Length ball on the stumps, defended near the pitch on the on side for a quick single.
Fuller on the stumps, Karunaratne flicks it to mid-wicket.
Bowls a bouncer down leg, Karunaratne does well to duck under it.
Length delivery on middle, Karunaratne plays it to mid-wicket.
Full on off, Karunaratne plays it off the front foot.
On a good length on middle, Lahiru defends it out.
BEATEN AGAIN! On a good length and outside off, Thirimanne looks to defend but misses it due to the away swing on this one.
BEATEN! Beauty of a delivery. On a good length and just outside off, Thirimanne looks to defend but misses it due to the seam movement on this one.
Good length delivery outside off, Thirimanne lets it go.
On a length on middle, Dimuth flicks it towards on side for a single.
Starts with a good length delivery outside off, Karunaratne shoulders his arms to this one.
Pat Cummins comes into the attack.

FOUR! This is right off the middle! Exquisite shot to end the over! Full and on off, Thirimanne leans into it and strokes it past the diving cover fielder for a boundary. 8 from it, but it was overall a good first over by Starc.
This one is angled into the batsman but the line is a little too straight. Thirimanne looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.

FOUR! That has flew off the edge! Sri Lanka are off the mark in a fortunate manner. Back of a length on off, the ball takes off after pitching. Thirimanne looks to defend but the ball flies off the shoulder and over the slip region for a one bounce boundary in the third man region.
Good carry there for the bowler! Length delivery and outside off, Thirimanne shoulders arms to it. The ball keeps rising after passing the batsman. Carey takes it at head height.
Goes fuller this time, there is a little shape away from the batsman. Thirimanne opens the face and guides it to point.
Starts with a good length and line but no swing. Just outside off, Thirimanne makes a leave.

We are all set for the action to begin! Out come the umpires and they are followed by the Australian players. Dimuth Karunaratne and Lahiru Thirimanne are the openers. Mitchell Starc will start the proceedings for Australia.

PITCH REPORT - Michael Clarke says the other day the surface was two-paced and it will probably be the same today. Mentions there should be a little bit of spin too today. Ends by saying it should be a good wicket overall, something for the bowlers and the batters.

Aaron Finch says the transition has been fine from T20 to 50-over format. Adds they have will have to adjust accordingly. Finch also says Smith and Warner are world-class players. On the changes, Nathan Coulter-Nile, Jason Behrendorff and David Warner miss out.
Dimuth Karunaratne says they would like to bat first. Adds that there will be little bit of turn on this track. He also says the youngsters have done well in the recent past.

We are awaiting the team news. Apparently, Warner, Coulter-Nile and Behrendorff are not playing. Maxwell, Cummins and Starc get a chance. Sri Lanka keep us waiting for their playing XI, XII, XIII, XIV or XV.
TOSS - Dimuth Karunaratne has won the toss and SRI LANKA WILL BAT FIRST.
WEATHER - Some grey clouds overhead. The forecast is for overcast skies but thankfully, NO RAIN. Let us hope it stays that way.

We are into the second round of the warm-up stage and it is Australia versus Sri Lanka at Southampton. Both sides enter this game with contrasting results - Australia getting the better of powerhouse England while Sri Lanka being mauled by the Proteas. Aaron Finch was not happy with the fielding so we know what Australia are looking at for improvement. Sri Lanka, well, need some kind of confidence to begin with. They have not been on any kind of winning run and a victory or even a good performance here might be a start for a turnaround.
